title: PG 10 Pack Pheromone Pads Refill Replacement Common Clothes Moth Infestation Room & Wardrobe Hanger Control Sticky Traps (Tineola Bisselliella)
bullet_points: LOCATE PREVENT MONITOR - Our professional-grade pheromone adhesive pads are designed for Common Clothes Moth (Tineola bisselliella) found in wardrobes and carpets. Use them to locate infestations, monitor treatments, and prevent new infestations

PHEROMONE CONTROL - Parts Guys pads emit a pheromone to attract male moths to the adhesive board, disrupting their lifecycle to monitor, prevent, and control infestations. Use with other treatments for established issues

SPECIFIC MOTH SPECIES - The pheromone works only for the Common Clothes Moth (Tineola bisselliella). It may affect similar species like Case-bearing Clothes & Pale-backed Clothes Moths, but it's not guaranteed. It won't work for any other moth species

OUR PAD HOLDERS - Our pads are made for the professional pest control industry and fit into specialised moth trap pad holders like our clear Pest Guys Hangers. While pads can be used alone, holders minimise contact with textiles and other objects nearby. Pads measure 130mm x 60mm and come in packs of 10

PAD PLACEMENT - Place pads where moth activity is known or suspected, such as wardrobes, carpets, and behind furniture. Moths will be attracted to the pads if present. Comprehensive instructions included
description: Pest Guys Common Clothes Moth Trap Description: Pheromone moth pads are an effective tool for identifying, monitoring, and controlling Common Clothes Moth (Tineola bisselliella) infestations. The pads contain a high-quality synthetic pheromone that attracts male moths to the adhesive surface, reducing the chances of reproduction and aiding in control efforts. Specifications: Pad Size: 133mm x 60mm Usage: Compatible with plastic moth hangers Product Options: Pest Guys offer kits that include both hangers and pheromone pads (quantities specified in the kit title). Replacement hangers and pads are also available individually. Usage Recommendations: Pheromone pads are most effective when used in combination with other insecticides, especially for larger infestations. They help identify active infestation areas, allowing for targeted treatment. Key Points: Attracts only male Common Clothes Moths Not suitable for other moth species Safe for use around children and pets Used by both professionals and amateurs Pest Guys Plastic Moth Hangers Description: Our UK-made plastic moth hangers are designed for versatile installation. They can be hung on wardrobe rails, door handles, nails, or placed under/behind furniture due to their slim profile, making them ideal for areas where moths are commonly found. Key Points: Can be hung in various locations Slim design for tight spaces Easy to assemble with provided instructions Fits pads measuring 60mm x 133mm Pest Guys pheromone pads and hangers provide a reliable solution for controlling Common Clothes Moths by preventing their reproduction and helping to pinpoint infestation areas for effective treatment.
